name: Sewing Tape Measure
summary: Ink sketch soft yellow cloth tailor's tape measure rolled into a coil; for sewing, tailoring and dressmaking scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the coil lies on y

params.name: s
params.note: hero scale: about 420 px across at s = 1; use about 0.25–0.35 next to a person

params.name: color
params.note: soft yellow of the cloth tape

params.name: anim
params.note: unroll = the tape strip slides out and back

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the tape then runs out to the left)

author: krakujs
